brands.name: Yokohama
brands.description: As the official importer of Yokohama tyres in Pakistan, J. Rashid & Sons brings world-class Japanese engineering and advanced rubber compounds to Pakistani roads.

about.heading: The Yokohama Story
about.history: The Yokohama Rubber Co. was born in 1917, merging Japanese engineering excellence with global vision. A century of motorsports dominance and relentless innovation has sculpted Yokohama into a titan of the tire industry, renowned for ultra-high-performance engineering and cutting-edge rubber compounds.
about.vision: To empower every driver globally with the ultimate driving experience, blending thrilling performance, unmatched safety, and deep respect for the environment.
about.mission: To engineer tires that redefine limits. We fuse cutting-edge technology with sustainable practices to craft products that inspire confidence on the track, the street, and the trail.

brands.name: Goodyear
brands.slogan: MADE TO FEEL GOOD & BUILT TO LAST
brands.description: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company is one of the world's largest tyre companies. J. Rashid & Sons provides authentic Goodyear tyres for passenger cars, SUVs, and commercial vehicles.

about.heading: The Goodyear Heritage
about.history: Founded in 1898 in Akron, Ohio, Goodyear quickly became an icon of American industry. From outfitting the Model T to supplying tires for the lunar rover, our legacy is built on a relentless drive to keep the world moving forward through continuous innovation.
about.vision: To be the world's most trusted mobility partner, leading the transition toward a sustainable, connected, and autonomous future of transportation.
about.mission: To deliver superior tire solutions and services that anticipate the evolving needs of our customers, driven by a culture of relentless innovation and operational excellence.

brands.name: Warrior
brands.description: Warrior tyres are built tough for Pakistani road conditions. Designed for durability and performance at competitive prices.

about.heading: The Warrior Legacy
about.history: Warrior Tyres emerged in the 1920s in Shanghai as a pioneering force in China's automotive revolution. Combining a century of heritage with strategic global partnerships, Warrior has evolved into a symbol of rugged durability, integrating modern European and Asian tire technologies.
about.vision: To be recognized globally as the premier symbol of unyielding strength, reliability, and immense value in the tire industry.
about.mission: To forge highly resilient and technologically advanced tires that conquer the most demanding conditions, providing drivers with safety and confidence on any road, anywhere.

brands.name: Atlas Tyre
brands.description: Atlas Tyres deliver superior traction and durability for a wide range of vehicles, ensuring a safe and comfortable ride across Pakistan.

about.heading: The Atlas Tradition
about.history: Originating in 1935 as the trusted tire brand for Standard Oil service stations across America, Atlas built its reputation on rock-solid reliability. Today, Atlas continues its storied tradition by delivering exceptional value, durability, and enduring quality to a new generation of drivers globally.
about.vision: To be the steadfast companion for every journey, seamlessly blending timeless reliability with modern automotive performance demands.
about.mission: To engineer accessible, high-quality tires that deliver outstanding mileage, safety, and comfort, ensuring that our customers always arrive at their destination with peace of mind.

brands.name: Risen
brands.description: Risen Tyres provide exceptional value and reliable performance, designed specifically to tackle tough road conditions with ease.

about.heading: The Risen Innovation
about.history: Risen Tyre represents the pinnacle of modern, intelligent tire manufacturing. Emerging as a dynamic force in the global market, Risen leverages state-of-the-art automated production to challenge the status quo and deliver premium performance at exceptional value.
about.vision: To revolutionize the smart mobility landscape by providing highly efficient, eco-conscious, and technologically superior tire solutions for the modern world.
about.mission: To utilize advanced tread design and sustainable compounds to produce tires that offer superior fuel efficiency, safety, and longevity, exceeding strict international standards without compromise.

brands.name: Falken
brands.description: Falken is known for its high-performance tires, offering precision handling and superior grip for sports cars and everyday driving.

about.heading: The Falken Journey
about.history: Born in 1983 as the high-performance division of Sumitomo Rubber Industries, Falken was forged in the heat of international motorsports. By dominating grueling endurance races like the 24 Hours of Nürburgring, Falken translates track-tested supremacy directly to the street.
about.vision: To be the heartbeat of automotive enthusiasm, continually pushing the boundaries of what is possible in ultra-high-performance and all-terrain mobility.
about.mission: To develop pulse-pounding, high-technology tires that deliver razor-sharp handling, exceptional grip, and unyielding durability for drivers who demand the very best from their vehicles.

brands.name: Sunwide
brands.description: Sunwide Tyres is a rapidly emerging brand known for providing highly reliable and cost-effective tire solutions for everyday drivers.

about.heading: The Sunwide Story
about.history: Sunwide has quickly gained a reputation in the international tire market by leveraging advanced manufacturing processes and focusing heavily on value-driven performance. Designed to meet everyday commuting needs with excellence, Sunwide is rapidly expanding its footprint across the globe.
about.vision: To become the most trusted and accessible tire brand for daily drivers worldwide, offering uncompromising safety at an exceptional value.
about.mission: To engineer tires that seamlessly blend durability, comfort, and efficiency, ensuring that every journey is smooth and secure.
